The tennis fixture is a reduced selection of real ESPN US Open competition objects retrieved on 2026-09-05. It keeps singles, doubles, live/scheduled/final states, and out-of-day matches. The NFL empty fixture was retrieved with dates=20260905 and legitimately contains no games. Provider facts are fixture samples, not bundled live content. The full 1.63 MB tennis response was separately tested from a local scratch file; tests/test_dashboard.cc accepts its path as the second argument after the preview directory.
